verdict.rationale: Vast.ai's docs explicitly describe templates as a first-class launch mechanism ('Launch prebuilt or custom templates with one click', 'A template is how Vast helps you launch an instance') and directly name PyTorch, vLLM, and ComfyUI as available prebuilt templates ('PyTorch, vLLM, ComfyUI, agents, and more. Real deployments you can copy'). CUDA support is implied through GPU offer filtering and template packaging but not explicitly named as its own template. missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of launching a specific named template (e.g., a community post describing a ComfyUI or vLLM template launch), and explicit CUDA-template documentation rather than inferred CUDA support.
